SELECT 
    d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
    ((d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) / d.XCL_028) * 100 AS percentage_change_unemployment
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 DESC
LIMIT 1
